title: Schools Close for Snow
text:
Yesterday, heavy snow fell across the city. Many schools closed early because the roads were dangerous. Buses stopped for two hours, so thousands of students could not go to school. The mayor said the schools would be open again on Monday.

Local people helped each other during the storm. Some neighbours cleared snow from the pavements with shovels. The police also asked drivers to stay at home unless their trip was important. Weather experts think the snow will stop by the weekend.

questions.text: How long did the buses stop?
What did some neighbours use to clear the snow?
Why did the police ask drivers to stay at home?
What can the reader infer about the people in the city?
options: They worked together to help each other
They wanted to leave the city
They were angry about the weather
They did not care about the students

vocabulary.definition: likely to cause harm or injury
very bad weather with strong wind and rain or snow
tools with a flat blade used to move snow or earth

paragraph_translations: Wczoraj ciężki śnieg spadł na całe miasto. Wiele szkół zamknięto wcześniej, ponieważ drogi były niebezpieczne. Autobusy stały przez dwie godziny, więc tysiące uczniów nie mogło pojechać do szkoły. Burmistrz powiedział, że szkoły znowu będą otwarte w poniedziałek.

Mieszkańcy pomagali sobie nawzajem podczas burzy. Niektórzy sąsiedzi odgarniali śnieg z chodników łopatami. Policja również poprosiła kierowców, aby zostali w domu, chyba że ich podróż była ważna. Eksperci pogody uważają, że śnieg przestanie padać do weekendu.
